audit_kind: Independent read-only audit of saved operational evidence
limits: Generated local homes only; no primary, archive, or cloud proof
Forced stop follows a durable flush; no power-loss or mid-publication crash proof
Retention uses a durable rollback reference; no concurrent-reader deletion-race stress
Payload map part zero only; no map-part-one operational proof
Orphans are made before startup; repeated sweep after an age-cutoff miss
Grace and startup delay are zero in automatic proofs; orphan minimum age is ten seconds
Receipt audit rechecks saved evidence and current artifacts; it does not run product operations
